name: karim-rn-motion
description: Motion for React Native and Expo. Reanimated 3/4 worklets, shared values and springs; Moti's declarative Framer-Motion-style layer on top; Skia for hardware-accelerated canvas and shaders; plus the choreography that ties them together across the components users touch (bottom sheets, swipeable rows, pull-to-refresh), animated icons (SF Symbols, Lottie), and screen transitions in expo-router and react-navigation.
